newsitem.title: CONGO: French planes take foreigners from Brazzaville.
newsitem.headline: French planes take foreigners from Brazzaville.

text.p: Four French military aircraft left the Congo capital Brazzaville on Monday with foreigners fleeing fighting in the city, diplomats said.
"Four Transall planes carrying about 90 people in each left this morning," said one diplomat.

The diplomats said that around 300 more French and other foreign nationals were waiting to be evacuated at two hotels in the city, where fighting has raged for five days between soldiers loyal to President Pascal Lissouba and ex-president Denis Sassou Nguesso's political militia.
They said three companies of French troops had set off for Brazzaville from their base in the Central African Republic capital, Bangui.
Residents near the centre of the city said firing had died down slightly since early morning, when shells were heard landing near the centre.
